findings.title: Scientific reinterprets unchanged function arguments after a locale change
findings.cause: The retained expression lacked origin metadata and submission used the current display locale decimal separator.
findings.remediation: Keep expression origin in the draft and apply the Scientific grammar at submission.

findings.title: Display locale was coupled to numeric normalization in retained editor states
findings.cause: Several workspaces kept raw numeric text and took punctuation rules from rendering. Standard had a distinct locale effect that rewrote existing editor text and edit history.
findings.remediation: Retain each editable field's notation or apply its locale-independent grammar. Keep structure, identifiers, metadata and mathematical numbers in their existing roles. Carry notation through active and suspended workspaces.

findings.title: The original expression alone did not identify its locale-specific syntax
findings.cause: Schema 1 already retained canonical input for replay. Its original expression could be ambiguous to an independent reader without its draft notation.
findings.remediation: Preserve canonical replay fields and add optional expression_locale provenance to new browser records within the existing size bound. Continue accepting earlier schema 1 records.
